description: Budget caps and limits for loop sessions (improvement list L52). scripts/loop/preflight.mjs reads this before a session starts any work; hitting a cap stops the loop for that night rather than slowing it. Values set by Tim on 8 November 2026: one session a night and a $20 monthly cap on the judges' API spend. The spend is estimated from this month's judge runs (scripts/loop/spend.mjs).
